summary.text: Mark Shirey, a Republican, has represented District 100 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he was born in DeKalb County, Alabama, earned a bachelor's degree in medical technology from the University of Alabama at Birmingham and a doctorate in optometry from the Southern College of Optometry.
He has worked as an optometrist and served as president of the Alabama Optometric Association.
